_Comment: Chance determines per-encounter spawn chance. Min and Max determine the minimum and maximum skeletons per spawn. If set to an integer, TierOverride will set the skeleton spawns to a static tier pool from Skeleton Crew rather than a scaling pool (3 is highest, 1 lowest). Archetypes will spawn only archetype skeletons, such as Venn the Graftling Necrobroker, if set to true.
